aboutText: Replace this paragraph from the admin dashboard with your professional introduction. Focus on the combination of marketing, real estate, CRM, automation, operations, and administrative support that best represents your work.

projects.title: Real Estate Marketing Campaign
projects.description: Insert a property campaign, brochure, social media creative, listing package, or investor marketing sample.
projects.challenge: Describe the business need or marketing objective.
projects.solution: Explain the campaign, assets, design, copy, or strategy you created.
projects.result: Add a measurable outcome or business benefit if available.

projects.title: Email Campaign / Newsletter
projects.description: Use this card for an email sequence, newsletter, investor update, outreach campaign, or nurture email.
projects.challenge: What audience or communication goal did the email address?
projects.solution: Describe your copywriting, design, segmentation, scheduling, or campaign setup.
projects.result: Insert opens, clicks, replies, conversions, or another outcome when available.

projects.title: Website or Landing Page
projects.description: Insert a live website, landing page, funnel, or screenshot of your web project.
projects.challenge: Describe the page objective, audience, or conversion requirement.
projects.solution: Explain the layout, copy, CTA strategy, responsive design, or lead capture experience.
projects.tools: Web Design, Landing Page, Lead Capture
projects.result: Add conversion, traffic, lead, or usability results where applicable.

projects.title: CRM Workflow
projects.description: Show a CRM pipeline, automation map, workflow builder, contact structure, or lead routing process.
projects.challenge: Describe the manual process, bottleneck, or follow-up problem.
projects.solution: Explain the workflow logic, triggers, actions, stages, integrations, and follow-up sequence.
projects.result: Show how the workflow reduced manual work or improved lead handling.

projects.title: Automation Dashboard / Demo
projects.description: Use video to demonstrate Make.com, Zapier, GoHighLevel, API, or other automation work.
projects.challenge: Explain what needed to happen automatically.
projects.solution: Describe the automation flow, integration, logic, or troubleshooting work.
projects.result: Insert saved time, fewer errors, faster response, or another operational result.

projects.title: Database Management Project
projects.description: Present spreadsheets, cleaned databases, dashboards, reporting tools, contact segmentation, or CRM data management.
projects.challenge: Describe the data accuracy, organization, or reporting requirement.
projects.solution: Explain cleanup, standardization, reporting, formulas, segmentation, or database structure.
projects.result: Add accuracy, reporting, productivity, or process improvements.

projects.title: SOP Documentation

projects.solution: Explain how you structured the steps, ownership, quality control, or training material.
projects.result: Add training, consistency, onboarding, quality, or handoff improvements.
